card.name: Inside names like Strongyloides stercoralis
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the start of a split-up proper name or organism name, such as 'st' in Strongyloides stercoralis or 'St' in Stevens-Johnson. It also fires on 'of' after 'overgrowth'.
